business: SEGMENT: PI car accident intake, Pleasanton (Shotland pilot)
prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
engine_stated_criteria: How many car-accident cases have you taken to trial—not just settled?
Who pays case expenses, and what happens if there is no recovery?
What is your assessment of my claim and its likely challenges?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t tell you definitively which lawyer is “best” without knowing the severity and details of your crash, but I’d interview **2–3 California personal-injury attorneys** before signing anything. Based on the available local listings, these are reasonable starting points:

- **Stephen M. Fuerch — Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch**  
  Pleasanton office; reports 35+ years in personal-injury law and focuses on car-crash cases. Free consultation: **(925) 463-2575**.  
  Website: [fuerchlegal.com](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/)

- **GJEL Accident Attorneys**  
  Has a Pleasanton office and handles car-accident injury claims. Free consultation and contingency representation are advertised. **(925) 833-8990**.  
  Website: [gjel.com/pleasanton](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton)

- **Mirador Law**  
  Pleasanton office; handles car, truck, and motorcycle collisions and serious injuries. Free consultation; contingency-fee arrangement advertised. **(925) 460-8484**.  
  Website: [miradorlaw.com](https://miradorlaw.com/pleasanton-personal-injury-lawyer/)

- **Venardi Zurada**  
  Serves Pleasanton and the Tri-Valley and advertises free consultations/no fee unless recovery. **(833) 893-6763**.  
  Website: [vzlawfirm.com](https://www.vzlawfirm.com/pleasanton/personal-injury-lawyer/)

### How I’d choose among them
Ask each lawyer:

1. **Who will personally handle my case?** A partner, associate, or case manager?
2. **How many car-accident cases have you taken to trial—not just settled?**
3. **What is the contingency percentage, and does it increase if litigation becomes necessary?**
4. **Who pays case expenses, and what happens if there is no recovery?**
5. **Do you have experience with disputed fault, uninsured/underinsured drivers, liens, or serious injuries?**
6. **What is your assessment of my claim and its likely challenges?**

Verify the lawyer’s California license and discipline history through the **California State Bar attorney search** before hiring. Avoid anyone who guarantees a dollar amount, pressures you to sign immediately, or gives legal advice without reviewing the facts.

Also, California generally has a **two-year deadline for injury lawsuits**, but shorter deadlines can apply to claims involving a government entity. Don’t give a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer or sign a release before getting legal advice.
